title: “Mile Sur Mera Tumhara”
text: On Independence Day 1988, Doordarshan first showed “Mile Sur Mera Tumhara”, sung in many of India’s languages by its best-loved voices.

title: “Mahabharat”
text: From October 1988, B. R. Chopra’s “Mahabharat” was shown on Sunday mornings. Streets fell quiet while it was on.
